title: The Use of Low Molecular Weight Heparin in Hemodiafiltration
brief_summary: Low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) is injected in the dialysis circuit at the start of the session. In the present study we compare 3 different methods of injection of LMWH: parameters of dialysis efficiency and clotting are measured. The study lasts 3 sessions for each patient.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* chronic kidney disease stade V treated with hemodiafiltration
* age \>18 year
* Hematocrit \> 30%

Exclusion Criteria:

* treatment with vitamin K antagonists
* treatment with other anti-coagulants or heparin besides the heparin used during dialysis
* active bleeding, infection or malignancy
* heparin associated allergy
* hepatic failure
* trombocytopenia \< 120.000/µl
